source: ENVIO plus independent public RPC receipt and Perpl context

checks.name: Policy preimage binding
checks.detail: The full supported policy preimage must hash to the supplied digest and match every claimed limit. This is integrity, not owner authentication.

checks.name: Declared scope
checks.detail: The claim binds policy digest, chain, exchange, transaction, account, market and quantity; it does not authenticate an owner.

checks.name: Chain evidence binding
checks.detail: Observed receipt must match the declared chain, transaction and exchange.

checks.name: External API context
checks.detail: Perpl public context identifies the same exchange, chain and market.

checks.name: API freshness
checks.detail: Current context must be no more than 120 seconds old and not materially future-dated.

checks.name: Transaction status
checks.detail: Receipt success is required; success alone does not prove a position reduction.

checks.name: Attributable position-decrease logs
checks.detail: 603 observed base units; target 603. Unsupported close-only logs without a quantity remain inconclusive.

limitations: Verifies named public observations only; owner signature and agent attribution are not established.
Receipt retrieval alone is not a finality proof.
CRE CLI simulation is local; no DON-deployed verification is implied.
